views.semanticNote: The two-axis paired ctDNA/TCR original is a hypothesis map, not validated clinical categories. TCR sequence expansion is not effector function; persistent DNA does not diagnose resistance, weak expansion does not assign chemotherapy causation, and best-pattern or clinically-good labels do not establish patient benefit. Consider assay origin, comparability, sampling and independent function.
